subject: math
topicName: College Entrance Review: Systems and Second-Degree Equations
description: Train entrance-exam algebra habits by solving systems of equations and quadratic equations with method choice, checking, and word-problem translation.
learningObjectives: Interpret the solution of a system as the ordered pair that makes both equations true
Choose between substitution and elimination based on the structure of a system
Solve quadratic equations by factoring or by using the quadratic formula
Use the discriminant and reasonableness checks to interpret and verify answers
